enchantments.tooltip: +3 Enhancement Bonus: +3 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Ooze Bane 2: This weapon is attuned specifically to disrupt Oozes, dealing an additional 2d10 bane damage vs. Oozes.
Crushing 5: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to ripple with force, dealing 5d6 force damage on each critical hit.
Blazing 5: This effect causes the edges of this weapon to coruscate, dealing 5d6 Light damage on each critical hit.
Smashing 5: The edges of this weapon are blunted, dealing an additional 5d6 bludgeoning damage on each critical hit.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
